issues.description: Removed 'category__in' default badge will break active filter display for category filter
issues.detail: The PR adds a Category filter on the findings page but simultaneously removes the 'category__in' entry from DEFAULT_FILTER_BADGES in active-filter-badge.tsx. Users selecting categories will no longer see an active filter badge with clear-functionality, contradicting the PR description claiming generic reusable active filter badges. Either keep the badge config or supply it elsewhere.

issues.description: Label-formatter applied to badge label but URL filter value may show formatted string
issues.detail: In data-table-filter-custom.tsx the displayLabel is passed both as item content and as badgeLabel via getBadgeLabel(entity, displayLabel). If badgeLabel feeds back into the selected-filter state or URL query (category__in=IAM instead of iam), the API call will fail. Verify badgeLabel is display-only and selection still uses raw value.

issues.description: getCategoryLabel heuristic produces wrong labels for known categories that were previously hardcoded
issues.detail: The old adapter had explicit labels like 'Trust Boundaries' for 'trustboundaries' and 'E3'/'E5' for short codes. The new heuristic splits on '-' only, so 'trustboundaries' becomes 'Trustboundaries' (regressing from 'Trust Boundaries'). The SPECIAL_CASES dict is empty. This is a user-visible regression for at least one category label.

issues.description: Duplicate value '4' for both Informational and Info in SEVERITY_ORDER
issues.detail: Adding Info: 4 alongside Informational: 4 creates two keys with the same ordering value. If the order map is used for sorting or lookup by index (reverse mapping), this will produce ambiguous results. Safer to alias Info to the same constant only where the API actually returns 'Info', or normalize at the boundary.

issues.description: Index collision between Category (index 5) and existing filter indexes in findings-filters
issues.detail: The new Category filter is inserted with index: 5 in findings-filters.tsx without showing what previously held that index. If another filter already uses index 5, ordering becomes non-deterministic. Verify filter index uniqueness or document the sort tiebreaker.

issues.description: Recomputing maxValue on every iteration inside map
issues.detail: In horizontal-bar-chart.tsx, maxValue = Math.max(...data.map(...)) is computed inside the .map callback for each item, making it O(n^2). Hoist the calculation above the map. Functionally correct but wasteful for large category sets.

review.summary: The PR cleanly extracts category label utilities and adds a Risk Radar category selector, but introduces a few concerns. Most notable: the active-filter-badge config for category__in was removed even though a Category filter was added, and the new heuristic-based getCategoryLabel regresses some prior explicit labels (e.g., 'Trust Boundaries' -> 'Trustboundaries'). The label formatter wiring into badgeLabel needs verification to ensure URL values stay raw. Smaller items: duplicate severity-order value for Info/Informational, possible filter index collision, and an O(n^2) maxValue computation in the bar chart.
